Route status: partly unverified
In the indicative +3 m river scenario, the nearest option Priya can route to from Elmina Lakeside Mall is the community hall candidate, about 56 m away on a wheelchair route. That route is partly unverified and rests on demo values, so check the path on the ground before relying on it. The official PPS school has no mapped connection from the mall, so I can't route her there.
Worth knowing:
• Partly unverified: flood status of an unnamed footway on the route is unknown (possibly flooded in this scenario).
• Demo values, not yet surveyed: step, incline and width data on that footway.
• Community hall (candidate) is an OpenStreetMap candidate, not an official PPS centre.
• Official PPS school: no mapped connection from Lakeside Mall (data gap), so it is not shown as unreachable.
• Urban Park playground is likely flooded in this indicative scenario.
• This is an indicative scenario, not a forecast. Follow official MBSA / JPS / NADMA guidance.

If the river rises 3 m (indicative scenario), the Urban Park playground is likely flooded and cut off. One unnamed path is likely flooded and another is possibly flooded. No place is fully isolated as an island.
1. Check Public InfoBanjir for official river levels: https://publicinfobanjir.water.gov.my
2. Avoid the playground and the flooded paths if the river rises to this level.
Worth knowing:
• This is an indicative scenario, not a forecast. Follow official MBSA / JPS / NADMA guidance.
• Path flood status comes from the indicative HAND model (Copernicus GLO-30), not a survey.
